create_gtn_graph: create a gtn Graph with start and accept nodes then add arcs with labels and weights
test_gtn_equal: test that two gtn Graph objects are structurally equal using gtn.equal comparing nodes arcs and weights
test_gtn_isomorphic: test that two gtn Graph objects are isomorphic using gtn.isomorphic ignoring node ordering
loadsave_gtn_savetxt_loadtxt: save a gtn Graph to a text file with gtn.savetxt and reload it with gtn.loadtxt
loadsave_gtn_save_load: save a gtn Graph to a binary file with gtn.save and reload it with gtn.load
